Australian MP Helen Haines Severely Injured in Targeted Vehicle Attack

Australian Federal Member for Indi, Helen Haines, sustained severe injuries, including the amputation of her leg, after being deliberately struck multiple times by a car outside her Wangaratta office. Police have charged Brendan Nugent in connection with the "targeted" attack. Nugent's family stated he had a longtime friendship with Haines. The incident has prompted commentary on the hostility faced by lawmakers.
